title: Rabbi Zerika (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tosefta Ohalot, end of chapter 18: Rabbi Zerika said, “On the fifth of the second Adar twenty-four elders voted on it,” etc. In the Mekhilta, Beshalach, parashah Vayassa, he expounded the verse “And Moses said: Eat it today” — from here, three meals on Shabbat. Hyman attributes this exposition to Rabbi Chidka in Shabbat 117b. In the consulted text, the Sages require three meals and Rabbi Chidka requires four, both from the same verse.

notes.text: The twenty-four elders voted on the matter. Hyman’s three-Sabbath-meals statement is retained as supplied. Named Davidson Shabbat 117b gives three meals to the Sages and four to Rabbi Chidka, preserving a substantive difference from Hyman’s wording.
